scope: Exact upstream H60 reserved handles, evaluated once with the complete frozen development-selected roster. Original bounded-versus-additive primary; no-tanh follow-up secondary. No retraining or reserved-outcome selection.
authorization: The user has repeatedly authorized all project data downloads, implementation, training and end-to-end evaluation; on 2026-09-20 they explicitly directed continued experiments without idle time. The independent pre-access scientific review is an implementation check, not a new user-permission request.

extraction.native_rows: All stored RGB and command rows; no resampling. Hash authorized raw files before extraction and record exact provenance.

evaluation.headline: equal_task_macro_of_task_specific_relative_H60_MSE_reductions
evaluation.followup_primary_secondary_contrast: unbounded_spatial_mix versus bounded_spatial_mix; follow-up family, not replacement of original primary
evaluation.paired_bootstrap: Resample matched training seeds, then ten trajectory clusters per task; share seed draws across tasks for macro reductions. Unadjusted percentile95 intervals.
evaluation.prefix_contract: Keep original H60 arrays at all59 offsets; separately evaluate H15/30/45 with only their own prefixes. Check CPU FP32 consistency with rtol1e-5,atol2e-5; retain gaps and all primitive prefix scores.
evaluation.target_access: Forecast receives only one observed feature vector and the causal recorded command prefix; target features enter scoring only.
evaluation.selection_after_access: None: no checkpoint, seed, task, horizon, hyperparameter or comparator deletion/replacement based on reserved outcomes.
evaluation.failure_policy: Stop on invalid identity, incomplete population or numerical mismatch; do not publish partial results as a completed study. Any science-changing repair requires a separately documented revision.

qualitative_selection.selection: Per task rank all200 handles by seed-mean H60 relative MSE reduction; choose minimum, lower median and maximum; ties lexicographic (episode_id,start). Keep full distribution and unfavorable cases.
qualitative_selection.followup_display: Show no-tanh and autoregression on those same predeclared handles, without selecting separate favorable cases for them.
qualitative_selection.labels: Recorded observed/reference RGB frames are not model-generated videos. Predictions/error maps are frozen-encoder feature quantities.
